name: Fire29 connected burning streaks
description: Remove the repeated yellow bushes completely: they look pasted onto the tile. Animate the ORIGINAL broad orange fire streaks as connected low irregular sheets of flame. Extend their own mottled painterly texture; do not invent separate geometric flame symbols. Let staggered sections of the existing bright streaks broaden and advance along their original paths, then thin and recede. At only two or three UNEVEN points tied to existing streak intersections, a wide irregular tapered sheet grows 10-14 source pixels outward over the far upper rim. Spill points shift a little along the rim as the front propagates, with bases always connected. It must read as the whole tile burning naturally at half-size, not static lava decorated with candle tufts. Match the original orange/red palette, minimize new pale yellow. Keep underlying dark rock/cracks, tile and camera fixed. Motion should visibly change contours and texture flow without global brightness change. Seamless32frames at20fps. No evenly spaced tongues, repeated rounded crowns, mountains, bushes, triangular icons, isolated sparks, needles, jets, synchronized pulses, flashes, or bending the entire shape.
